response.sql: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(ab.abhvreg) as analysis_count, COUNT(ab.abhvreg) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advancedbehavior ab2 INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr2 ON ab2.translink = tr2.transreg INNER JOIN trader t2 ON tr2.trdref = t2.tradereg) as proportion FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind ORDER BY t.tradekind
